messages.subject: Project Ember — draft completion statement & funds
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Priya,

Draft completion statement attached. The balance due from you on completion (15 May) is approximately £21,701,299, made up of the price less the deposit, plus/less the apportionments and the rent deposits credited to you, and the £100k retention held by us. This excludes SDLT (£1,227,000) and Land Registry fees, which we'll deal with after completion.

Please arrange for completion funds to reach our client account by 12.00 on 14 May. Let me know if anything looks off.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0537
